title: The high shelf
goals: Bring down the rare book and carry it.
Walk on to the end of the aisle.
starting_code: # The book is on the top shelf. Stand in line with it, near enough, and cast fendra.
hints: fendra reaches three tiles, straight up, down, left or right, over the shelves.
Walk along the aisle until the book is straight above the wizard.
After the spell, the book lies on the wizard's tile: pick it up.
intro: That book is on the top shelf, and no one climbs my shelves. You have your wand, and now you know fendra.
